evidence.title: Cozy Aesthetic Room Ideas for Trendy Bedroom Designs - VisualHunt

name: VisualHunt
summary: Photo-led home decor and furniture idea site, browsable by room and product category.
description: VisualHunt collects interior decorating and home product ideas as photo-led articles written by designers, organised in categories such as furniture, decor & pillows, lighting, rugs, bed & bath, kitchen & tabletop, outdoor, pet and storage & organisation. Idea pages link to similar products and subcategories, and the homepage lists trending ideas.
contains: photo-led idea articles, e.g. Cozy Aesthetic Room Ideas for Trendy Bedroom Designs
categories: furniture, decor & pillows, lighting, rugs, bed & bath, kitchen & tabletop, outdoor, pet and more
subcategories such as bedroom, living room and accent furniture
trending ideas list on the homepage
author pages, e.g. designer Lily Wright
